mainEntity.name: What is post-concussion syndrome and how can an attorney help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Post-concussion syndrome (PCS) refers to a complex set of symptoms that can persist for weeks, months, or even years after a concussion. These symptoms may include headaches, dizziness, fatigue, irritability, anxiety, and difficulty concentrating. An attorney specializing in personal injury, particularly brain injuries, can help you navigate the legal process to seek compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering resulting from PCS. They investigate the accident, gather medical evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies or pursue litigation to protect your rights.
